sql: SELECT d.forename || ' ' || d.surname AS full_name, d.nationality, r.name AS first_race FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON res.driverId = d.driverId JOIN races r ON r.raceId = res.raceId WHERE d.dob = (SELECT MAX(d2.dob) FROM drivers d2 WHERE d2.driverId IN (SELECT driverId FROM results)) ORDER BY r.date ASC, r.round ASC LIMIT 1;
